subject: POC handshake: success targets, SLA asks, and ops roster
thread_body:
From: Aisha Verma <aisha.verma@cerebellum.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + POC success asks

Hi Jonas / Ben,

Thanks for the call earlier — good sync. Quick recap from our side and the things we need to lock down before we sign the PO: 

- Workload profile: 512-token average requests, 90% of calls under 800 tokens.
- Latency target: p99 end-to-end < 300ms for single-request flow (we can tolerate higher for large contexts during batch runs).
- Throughput: baseline 15 qps, spike to 40 qps during peak ingest windows.
- Cost objective: target effective cost < $0.0009 per token (we'll use this to model production spend).
- Quality: on our 120 prompt test-suite, we need >= 88% pass-rate on relevance criteria (we'll share exact labels).

Must-haves before contract: SOC2 evidence + basic data retention and deletion language, procurement contact for SOW/PO, one-week smoke test with our replay dataset.

Next steps we want from Redwood: a compact POC runbook that maps who owns what (technical owner, SRE contact, timeline), and an instrumentation checklist that will let us measure latency/throughput/cost during the POC. Can you send a draft by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Verma
VP Engineering | Cerebellum Labs
--

---
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Verma <aisha.verma@cerebellum.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC success asks

Aisha — thanks for the clear list. High level plan attached (POC-plan-v1.pdf) and summary below. I'll be the primary sales lead and Ben will run the technical onboarding / SRE coordination. Marissa will own evaluation instrumentation and quality metrics.

POC overview (4-week handshake):
- Week 0 (prep): access + security paperwork; benchmark replay dataset delivery (you); baseline cost projection.
- Week 1: deployment & smoke tests (single-node Dedicated pool) — confirm p50/p95/p99 latency.
- Week 2: scale tests (ramp to 40 qps) + throughput profiling + KV-cache warmup runs.
- Week 3: quality validation against your 120 prompt set (blind scoring) + cost simulation.
- Week 4: readout and go/no-go decision (joint scoring sheet).

Success criteria (proposal):
- Latency: p99 inference latency < 300ms for 512-token median context (measured excluding network egress to your client).
- Throughput: sustain 15 qps steady-state with capacity to handle 40 qps spikes for 5+ min windows without >5% request throttling.
- Cost: model-based estimate <= $0.0009 / token when using the recommended quantized model variant and caching.
- Quality: >= 88% pass on your relevance rubric; no regressions vs baseline production model on a subset of critical prompts.

Measurement plan (short):
- We will run a replay harness you provide (ben will coordinate formats).
- Collect server-side traces (per-request token counts, latency buckets, cache hit-rate) and export to the shared Drive dashboard.
- Quality will be assessed by blind raters you supply or by automated label checks you provide; we'll provide a CSV template for results.

Owners:
- Sales: jonas_weber (primary contact)
- Tech onboarding/SRE: ben_carter
- Eval instrumentation & quality: marissa_cole
- Legal/procurement: we'll work with your procurement contact once you intro them.

Attachments: POC-plan-v1.pdf (high level runbook + checklist).

I can have the instrumentation checklist and a short security checklist (SOC2 mapping) over to you by tomorrow EOD. Does that timeline work?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Verma <aisha.verma@cerebellum.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC success asks

Hi Aisha — looping in a concise instrumentation plan and ownership table below, plus I attached an eval-instrumentation-checklist.csv that we'll use to capture results.

Instrumentation & measurement specifics (technical):
- Latency: measure server-side generation latency (tokenization start -> last token emitted) and report p50/p95/p99. We'll include client-to-server RTT in a second column so you can decide on end-to-end vs server-only.
- Throughput: RPS measured at the load-gen gateway; we'll run steady-state at 15 qps for 10 minutes and burst runs to 40 qps for three 5-minute windows.
- Cache metrics: track prefix KV cache hit-rate and cold-start penalty per key.
- Cost: we'll log token counts per request, mapped to the model/quantization profile used; Redwood will provide a cost model for the run.
- Quality: we'll accept your CSV of labeled prompts; we'll compute pass-rate and also provide top-line examples for any fails for debugging.

Ownership table (single-line):
- Redwood infra & runtime: ben_carter (SRE lead)
- Eval instrumentation and analysis: marissa_cole (PM)
- Sales / contract: jonas_weber
- Customer data transfer & replay harness: Aisha (you) / your eng lead

Dashboard & artifacts: I've created a shared doc for the readout: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aPOC-runbook-example 

Aisha — small ask: can you confirm what your acceptance threshold for p99 should be if you include client-side network time? Also, please introduce procurement@cerebellum.ai to me so we can get the SOW loop started.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: eval-instrumentation-checklist.csv (columns: test-name, target, measurement-method, owner)

---
From: Aisha Verma <aisha.verma@cerebellum.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com; marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC success asks

Thanks — plan looks good. A few updates:

1) Procurement intro: procurement@cerebellum.ai. Please include SOW + estimated monthly spend assumptions in the first pass.
2) Client-inclusive p99: if we include our network RTT, we need p99 < 350ms. If you report server-only p99 < 300ms, that works for our internal modeling; we will reconcile both in the readout.
3) We will provide the labeled 120-prompt set and a 48-hour replay window of production traffic for Week 1 smoke. We'll aim to start the POC next Monday (07/24). Can you confirm availability?

Attached: security-questionnaire.pdf — please have your security/compliance lead confirm SOC2 scope and any additional evidence we should expect.

If Redwood can confirm start date and send SOW draft plus the instrumentation checklist filled with owners by EOD Monday (07/22), we'll route PO the same week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Aisha
VP Engineering | Cerebellum Labs

--
[Attachment stubs referenced: POC-plan-v1.pdf, eval-instrumentation-checklist.csv, security-questionnaire.pdf]
